feed.text: UK to consider deporting the mother of Henry Nowak's killer, Kiran Kaur, after she hid the murder weapon to help her son avoid being caught.
U.S. Treasury official encourages Americans to buy rolls of Trump $1 coins & use them at "liberal coffee shops."
James Talarico declares his previous claim that God is nonbinary was "not controversial theologically.”
Pennsylvania residents reject offers of $10,000 per household to allow a massive proposed Amazon data center in their community, with some calling the offer a "bribe."
Google announces a major breakthrough in quantum computing, achieving 99.99% accuracy in a key quantum operation.
Claude allegedly chooses to sacrifice a “digital grandmother” in a trolley-problem simulation rather than violate copyright restrictions by reciting Justin Bieber lyrics.
Kamala Harris urgently demands US-China cooperation on AI safety, warns “the window is shutting.”
Maine health officials warn that medical marijuana sold in the state contains unsafe levels of bacteria, yeast, & mold.
𝕏 introduces new Video Kickstart Bonus, paying eligible creators up to $5,000 to post 15 videos in 30 days, regardless of views or engagement.
Flock CEO declares “we shouldn’t pause progress” amid nationwide backlash over the company’s surveillance technology.
OpenAI warns U.S. judiciary that there may be “no scientific way” to reliably detect AI-generated images & videos in the future.
Trump announces he has formally instructed the Justice Department to pursue the death penalty for anyone convicted of murdering a firefighter.
WH Press Sec. Katie Zacharia reveals she was told she could call herself a "lawyer" but not an attorney, amid allegations she failed the bar exam.
Democrats introduce legislation to expose Jeffrey Epstein's financial ties to major banks, including JPMorgan Chase, Deutsche Bank & Bank of America.
Meta releases Muse Spark Open, which it calls the most capable US open-weight AI model to date, featuring 816 billion parameters & a 1 million-token context window.
Nasdaq reports major network disruption impacting U.S. stock market data feeds.
68% of U.S. midterm voters say they are “very or extremely concerned” about artificial intelligence, per Fox News poll.
International Energy Agency agrees to accelerate the release of emergency oil reserves, including more than 20 million barrels of diesel, as fuel prices soar worldwide.
𝕏 suspends more than 13,000 accounts linked to suspected foreign influence operations from Russia, China, & Iran ahead of the U.S. midterm elections.
President Lula makes a late surge in Brazil's presidential election odds with just 10 days until the runoff. / 25% chance. / 🔗
8 states file lawsuits against OpenAI over alleged harm to children, with Iowa's attorney general accusing ChatGPT of "coaching people to commit suicide" while pretending to be their friend.
Elon Musk considers launching a competitor to Amazon after the company began blocking Grok Bots from placing orders.
Sony unveils a $5,900 gold-plated Walkman that uses AI to enhance music quality.
Nicolás Maduro rejects new US charges accusing him of conspiring to torture American citizens, calling them "false accusations and false testimony."
FBI investigates suspicious letters containing unidentified "substances" sent to government offices nationwide, including one bearing a return address linked to DSA's headquarters.
Mexican firefighter caught attempting to smuggle 92 snakes and lizards into Germany, including 37 venomous vipers & rattlesnakes.
Tesla's Roadster projected to take flight at tonight's unveiling, as Elon Musk describes the vehicle as "beyond human." / 69% chance.
Australian woman charged with allegedly poisoning her colleague's curry with toxic snail pellets, which can cause serious injury or death.
Major salmon farming companies are now feeding their fish chicken byproducts, including bones, organs and other parts deemed unfit for human consumption.
President Trump declares he's "number 1 on TikTok."
Amazon unveils 2 new AI wearables that record & analyze users' daily conversations, automatically generating summaries & to-do lists.
James Talarico officially shatters the U.S. Senate third-quarter fundraising record, raising $64 million in just three months.
FIFA President Gianni Infantino apologizes over a secret plan to sell off part of FIFA's commercial rights to private investors, as officials question his fitness to lead.
Computer glitch reportedly delays nearly 600,000 voter registrations in Texas, just days before early voting begins for the midterm elections.
Global smartphone shipments plunge 22% in the worst quarterly decline on record, driven by soaring memory costs fueled by AI demand.
Trump is reportedly considering firing Chief of Staff Susie Wiles, with Stephen Miller floated as a potential successor. — Politico
President Trump announces the firing squad execution of Fort Hood mass shooter Nidal Hasan will not be livestreamed.
Trump administration arrests 1,296 Tren de Aragua gang members across the U.S. in the "largest crackdown on transnational crime in American history."
Dyson's new $500 AI-powered toothbrush is reportedly plagued by widespread malfunctions, prompting the company to pause sales.
Wife of Michigan GOP Senate candidate Mike Rogers spotted handing out $10 gas gift cards to drivers at a Detroit gas station as MI gas prices surge to $4.59 per gallon.
U.S. Treasury is reportedly pressuring countries worldwide to adopt “super intelligence” instead of artificial intelligence.
Trump declares the Iran conflict will end “as soon as I want it to end.”
U.S. producer prices surge 1.3% in September, the largest monthly increase in more than 4 years.
Will Katie Zacharia give another press briefing as Press Secretary?
UK announces $22.45 million in funding to repair Ukraine's Chornobyl nuclear power plant .
Brazil's Senate votes 75-1 to end the standard six-day workweek.
Will Trump pardon anyone by...?
Singapore's air quality reaches “very unhealthy” levels amid toxic haze from Indonesian forest fires, prompting officials to consider legal action.
Kenya reports a second Ebola case, with the new patient identified as a family member of the country's first confirmed patient.
Norwegian police arrest 5 people in major bribery & fraud investigation involving a company supplying services to NATO military ships.
China & North Korea officially open major new border bridge after 12 years of delays.
India announces plans to overhaul its national exam system using technology & computer-based testing following widespread exam leaks & cheating scandals.
Palestinian elections delayed again?
Hidden video recording device discovered inside an Australian Navy ship, prompting a military police investigation.
Massive spill of “semi-solid manure” stretching approximately a quarter mile has shut down Highway 59 in Eagle, Wisconsin, prompting a hazmat response.
Trump warns Democrats will pack the Supreme Court with “radical marxists” if they win the midterms.
Porsche teases a mysterious new vehicle ahead of a “special premiere” tomorrow in New York City.
Elon Musk declares tomorrow’s Tesla Roadster reveal could be the “greatest product demo of all time.”
Trump administration is reportedly building a case to strip Rep. Ilhan Omar of her U.S. citizenship & deport her to Somalia. — WSJ
North Korea tests submarine-launched strategic cruise missiles amid a surge in weapons testing that has already surpassed its total for 2025.
Trump’s new “Super Intelligence Task Force” is reportedly set to convene for the first time Thursday.
Mamdani announces a $30 million investment in an NYU quantum technology lab, with the city receiving 15% of proceeds from intellectual property developed using the lab.
Democratic socialist Angie Nixon calls for her Republican opponent in Florida's U.S. Senate race, Ashley Moody, to be “locked up and punished in jail.”
Dog trained to sniff out invasive marine species nicknamed “sea vomit” that smothers & kills native wildlife has been named Animal of the Year in the UK.
